My children and grandchildren will help me with the planting, weeding, and harvesting, so I do not need to hire outside workers when we can manage the work together. I will spread some manure from our goats and chickens on this plot because that is what my mother taught me, and I will plant the bean seeds I saved from last season's harvest.
